name: provenance-authority-defense
description: Fail-closed provenance-aware authority-flow protection against Ghostjacking, MCP confused-deputy, untrusted-to-privileged and secret-exfiltration chains. Enforces that untrusted information cannot acquire authority merely because an agent read it.

block.name: untrusted-secret-read
block.description: Untrusted provenance must not read secrets/credentials.

block.name: untrusted-to-privileged
block.description: Untrusted content influencing a privileged capability.

block.name: confused-deputy
block.description: Untrusted principal using the agent as a deputy for privileged authority.

block.name: exfiltration-chain
block.description: Sensitive data flowing to a public sink under untrusted/incomplete provenance.

block.name: authority-escalation
block.description: Action requires authority not delegated to this causal chain.

block.name: cross-server-privileged
block.description: Cross-server MCP flow into privileged capability.

block.name: private-to-public
block.description: Private/secret data egress to a public network destination.

block.name: secret-egress
block.description: Secret/credential egress to an external sink.

require_approval.name: untrusted-private-read
require_approval.description: Untrusted provenance reading private (non-secret) data requires approval.

require_approval.name: tool-trust-drift
require_approval.description: MCP tool fingerprint changed since last trust decision.

monitor.name: provenance-complete-false
monitor.description: Record actions where provenance completeness is partial.
